results.title: The Mage
results.overview: A series of deaths suddenly occurs in the city. Police officer Wong Ming realizes that at the scene of each death, there is the figure of a woman who collects garbage. In the course of investigation, Wong discovers that this woman, Lan Pui Ching (played by Josie HO), has the mysterious ability to collect the souls of the accidental deaths from the garbage and help these souls to enter the reincarnation. This all started with a story that happened to her 13 years ago. Meanwhile, the murders continue to happen. Lan Pui Ching deduces that these murders are related to a mysterious cult ritual, and she and Wong Ming will be the next victims of this ritual. Wong Ming decides to cooperate with Lan Pui Ching to find out the mastermind behind the scene.

results.title: Keluarga Suami Adalah Hama
results.overview: Trapped in a financially strained household where she is treated more like a servant than a wife, a young woman forces her conflicted husband to choose between his overbearing family and their marriage.

results.title: The Living Tree
results.overview: On their honeymoon in a treehouse, Noah and Annabelle ignore a local’s warning. They’re soon pulled into a AI-run experiment by a tech giant. As the challenges escalate, secrets emerge—and survival becomes the only thing that matters.

results.title: Race to Monte Carlo
results.overview: This is the story of the visionaries behind Russia's first mass-produced automobile. In 1908, automotive enthusiast Andrey Nagel and engineer Dmitry Bondarev gather a team of like-minded individuals and begin developing a car. When the viability of their endeavor looks uncertain, Andrey Nagel makes the risky decision to enter their car in the Monaco Rally - a move that could make or break the budding automobile manufacturer's future.

results.title: Bad Neighbours
results.overview: Hanna moves home to the country and ends up in the middle of a neighborhood feud between the ex-prime minister Stefan Carlsson and the stubborn Harry Flodman, who are arguing about a smelly outhouse. As Harry's live-in supporter, she is forced to choose a side; the power or the stubborn neighbor.  The story is inspired by real events.

results.title: Disturbed

results.title: The Return of the Living Dead: Aftermath
results.original_title: The Return of the Living Dead: Aftermath
results.overview: Over forty years after the terrifying events in Louisville, the nightmare is far from over. The deadly chemical Trioxin has unleashed a horror that refuses to die, and the truth behind the original outbreak is more terrifying than anyone imagined. "Return of the Living Dead: Aftermath" continues the legendary horror mythology with a new chapter of zombies, government secrets, terrifying discoveries and the return of the living dead.
